items.issue: The Short presents self-criticism causing lower self-esteem and depleted capacity to change as a broad causal chain without supporting evidence.
items.disposition: Keep as the speaker's framing, not a clinical or universal fact; disable action-advice use.

items.issue: The self-acceptance example includes having hurt others and could be misused to bypass apology, repair, consequences or the harmed person's boundaries.
items.disposition: Preserve the explicit accountability boundary and do not turn acceptance into exoneration.

items.issue: The core acceptance-plus-change principle is already represented by quark-live-007 and the formal parent of short-005.
items.disposition: Assign zero weight and keep only as a research pointer.
